ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the circle $\odot O$, the chord $AC\parallel$ to the radius $OB$, $\angle BOC=48^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle OAB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AC \parallel OB$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOC = \angle ACO = 48^\circ$,\\
since $OA = OC$,\\
then $\angle OAC = \angle ACO = 48^\circ$,\\
since $\angle CAB = \frac{1}{2} \angle BOC = 24^\circ$,\\
hence $\angle BAO = \angle OAC - \angle CAB = \boxed{24^\circ}$.
